text:
The whisper-path proposal is clear, and I logged one "clear" line in `flags.jsonl`.

`node Server/text-check.mjs` printed no flags. The title states the goal, and the two asks are numbered and short. The Do and Fences sections are brief, with no paragraph over the limit.

It names two agents, `mastermind-dictation-v3` and `vscode-mastermind`, without links. I left that alone because `requirements.md` is written for agents, not the owner. I didn't open any page, since this proposal has none.

I've written the review to `whisper-path/review.md`, with verdict: fix. It has four fixes and three notes.

The fixes:
- **Doc index:** `ux/Dictate/doc/upload.md` is not listed in `ux/Dictate/doc/files.jsonl`.
- **No outcome on the task:** the folder has no landed note or four-line report. It also has no per-hop V1/V2/V3 timings for the `Sessions.say` write and the view draw.
- **V1 and the copy:** the new 8-bit mu-law audio format also reaches V1 (`variants/v1/Dictate.js:340`), but V1 doesn't get the drop-a-guess-in-flight fix. The `audio/MicStream` copy still says 16-bit.
- **Stale V3 comment:** the comment at `ext/Chat/v3/ChatV3.css:17-18` still says the draft is gray, but `.chat-v3-text.is-moving` is now solid.

The notes:
- `silence.md:73` still claims 16-bit WAVs.
- The new colour pair isn't in the colour docs, and V2 raw lines are now full ink.
- `--final-ink: currentColor` does nothing on its own.

I made no code edits. I did not open the two shots (`shots/ink-1200.png`, `shots/ink-400.png`). I also didn't run the check scripts or confirm the timing numbers in `upload.md`.
